text: いきおい　つけすぎた　かな？

structure.jp: いきおい　つけすぎた

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる stuck onto a verb means doing it too much. いきおい　つけすぎた = 'I built up too much momentum'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', said half to yourself. つけすぎた　かな = 'did I overdo it, I wonder'.
